- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0005 · AVOID — Don’t hide an Apple Pay button or make it appear unavailable · Apple Pay > Offering Apple Pay ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0009 · AVOID — Avoid requiring account creation before purchase · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0017 · AVOID — Avoid forcing compliance with your business logic · Apple Pay > Handling problems > Data validation errors ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0026 · AVOID — Don’t translate Apple Pay or any other Apple trademark · Apple Pay > Referring to Apple Pay ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0001 · SHOULD — Offer Apple Pay on all devices and browsers that support it · Apple Pay > Offering Apple Pay ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0002 · SHOULD — Make Apple Pay the primary payment option when credentials are available · Apple Pay > Offering Apple Pay ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0003 · SHOULD — Use Apple Pay buttons only to initiate payment or, when appropriate, the Apple Pay setup process · Apple Pay > Offering Apple Pay ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0004 · SHOULD — Use the Apple Pay mark graphic only to communicate that you accept Apple Pay · Apple Pay > Offering Apple Pay ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0006 · SHOULD — Provide a cohesive checkout experience · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0007 · SHOULD — Support coupons and promotional codes in the payment sheet · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0008 · SHOULD — Prefer checkout information from Apple Pay · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0010 · SHOULD — Display an order confirmation or thank-you page · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0011 · SHOULD — Display the active coupon or promotional code, or let people enter one · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout > Customizing the payment sheet ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0012 · SHOULD — Let people choose the shipping method in the payment sheet · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout > Customizing the payment sheet ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0013 · SHOULD — Use line items to explain additional charges, discounts, pending costs, add-on donations, recurring payment… · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout > Customizing the payment sheet ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0014 · SHOULD — Keep line items short · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout > Customizing the payment sheet ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0015 · SHOULD — Provide a business name after the word Pay on the same line as the total · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout > Customizing the payment sheet ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0016 · SHOULD — Defer to the payment sheet for progress information during payment · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout > Customizing the payment sheet ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0018 · SHOULD — Include line items that reiterate billing frequency, discounts, and additional upfront fees · Apple Pay > Supporting subscriptions ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0019 · SHOULD — Use a line item to identify a donation · Apple Pay > Supporting donations ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0021 · SHOULD — Position the Apple Pay button correctly in relation to an Add to Cart button · Apple Pay > Using Apple Pay buttons > Button size and position ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0022 · SHOULD — Maintain the minimum button size and margins around the button · Apple Pay > Using Apple Pay buttons > Button size and position ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0023 · SHOULD — Use only the artwork provided by Apple, with no alterations other than height · Apple Pay > Using Apple Pay buttons > Apple Pay mark ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0024 · SHOULD — Maintain a minimum clear space around the mark of 1/10 of its height · Apple Pay > Using Apple Pay buttons > Apple Pay mark ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0028 · SHOULD — Clearly disclose when people may incur additional costs after payment authorization · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout > Customizing the payment sheet ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0029 · SHOULD — Accurately report problems to the system · Apple Pay > Handling problems > Data validation errors ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0030 · SHOULD — Clearly communicate trial period terms · Apple Pay > Supporting subscriptions ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
- HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0027 · MAY — For in-store pickup, consider letting people choose a pickup window that works for them · Apple Pay > Streamlining checkout > Customizing the payment sheet ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/apple-pay))
